prompt.text:
Implement Go-struct field matching from source text in one standard-library-only Go file using package `solution`.

Export `type FieldMatch struct { Destination, Source string }` and `func InspectFieldMatches(destinationSource, destinationType, sourceSource, sourceType string) ([]FieldMatch, error)`.

Parse each source string as a complete Go file and locate the named struct type. Return an error for malformed source, a missing name, or a named type that is not a struct. Consider only explicitly named fields whose names begin with uppercase ASCII `A` through `Z`; ignore embedded and unexported fields. Match names case-insensitively using ASCII lowercase and only when their rendered Go type expressions are identical. If multiple eligible source fields have the same case-insensitive name, that name is ambiguous and none may match it. Preserve destination declaration order, including the order of names in a multi-name field declaration. Empty structs return a non-nil empty slice. Do not modify or retain the source strings.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
